<div class="sphinxpress-doc">
<section id="logseq-profile">
<h1>Logseq Profile</h1>
<p>The Logseq profile makes WikiMason work with Logseq graph directories.</p>
<section id="path-mapping">
<h2>Path mapping</h2>
<p>Logseq stores pages flat in <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">pages/</span></code>. Namespaces are encoded into filenames:</p>
<div class="highlight-text notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>PageRef(&quot;Wiki/Tech/Strapi&quot;)  -&gt;  pages/Wiki___Tech___Strapi.md
pages/Wiki___Tech___Strapi.md  -&gt;  PageRef(&quot;Wiki/Tech/Strapi&quot;)
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>The namespace separator defaults to <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">___</span></code> (triple underscore) and can be
configured in <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">[profile.logseq]</span></code>.</p>
</section>
<section id="metadata-format">
<h2>Metadata format</h2>
<p>Logseq uses <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">property::</span> <span class="pre">value</span></code> lines at the top of each page:</p>
<div class="highlight-text notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>type:: knowledge
domain:: tech
confidence:: high
created:: 2026-05-29
updated:: 2026-05-29

- ## Deployment Pipeline
  - CI/CD workflow for production.
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>Properties are parsed from the top of the file until a non-property block is
encountered. Lists (<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">tags</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">sources</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">topics</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">aliases</span></code>) use
comma-separated values.</p>
</section>
<section id="body-rendering">
<h2>Body rendering</h2>
<p>The Logseq profile converts internal standard Markdown to outliner blocks:</p>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p>Headings: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">-</span> <span class="pre">##</span> <span class="pre">Heading</span></code> (nested)</p></li>
<li><p>Lists: nested with block depth</p></li>
<li><p>Code fences: preserved as child blocks</p></li>
<li><p>Tables: nested under a parent block</p></li>
</ul>
<div class="admonition note">
<p class="admonition-title">Note</p>
<p>WikiMason preserves Markdown-like structure internally, but Logseq’s
visual editor may render nested tables and fenced code blocks
differently. Prefer small, simple blocks in Logseq-authored pages.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section id="init-layout">
<h2>Init layout</h2>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">wikimason</span> <span class="pre">init</span> <span class="pre">logseq</span></code> creates:</p>
<div class="highlight-text notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>pages/
  Wiki___index.md
  Wiki___Dashboard.md
  Wiki___Tech.md
  Wiki___Projects.md
  Wiki___Schema.md
journals/             (optional)
Raw/Sources/
Schema/
_templates/
AGENTS.md
wikimason.toml
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="profile-changes">
<h2>Profile changes</h2>
<p>WikiMason does not expose profile migration commands in the current
pre-release surface. To move between profiles, create a fresh target
vault and then use canonical verification/build commands after copying
content:</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>wikimason<span class="w"> </span><span class="nb">source</span><span class="w"> </span>verify
wikimason<span class="w"> </span>index<span class="w"> </span>build
wikimason<span class="w"> </span>lint
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
</section>
</div>
